Chlorophyll or Solar Power{{sup/md|SMD}}|| pokemonname=Sunflora| evolution=1 | firstevoep=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness | firstevoname=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness | firstevonametiming=Prior to| numeps1=an unknown number of | firststagename=Sunkern | prevonum=191| evo1num=192 | epnum=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness| epname=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness| current=At [[Wigglytuff's Guild]] | java1=N/A| enva2=[[Rachael Lillis]] [[Emily Bauer Jenness]] (Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time and Darkness) | java2=Hiroko Emori | }} '''Sunflora''' (Japanese: '''キマワリ''' ''Kimawari'') is a [[non-player character]] in {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness}} and {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky}}. She is a member of [[Wigglytuff's Guild]]. ==Background== Sunflora has been an apprentice at [[Wigglytuff's Guild]] for at least quite some time, apparently being already an apprentice a long time before the {{pkmn2|hero}} and their {{md|Partner Pokémon|partner}}, and calling the two 'cute', implying she's also older than they are. She is one of the most gifted apprentices at the Guild, as shown when she is chosen to apprehend Haunter, who was thought to be invincible. She was also given the chance to graduate once, but turned it down in favor of more training. She has a rocky relationship with Loudred, shown in both the main storyline and the special episode "Today's Oh My Gosh", the cause of which is never directly revealed, but her diary suggests this might be because Loudred got her knocked out of a dungeon once by storming off recklessly. This is shown in her often making rude remarks about Loudred. An example is when Loudred commented on what he would do if he lost his memory, during the strategy meeting at [[Foggy Forest]], saying it wouldn't matter because he's forgetful anyway. Her diary entries about the events of the special episode, however, claim she has warmed up to Loudred a little after this. She still makes occasional rude remarks to Loudred after this though. She later reappears in Super Mystery Dungeon as a recruitable character. ==Personality== Sunflora often acts very hyper and excitable, using terms like "Oh my gosh" frequently when speaking. Underneath her girly exterior, however, she is very kind and loyal to her guild members, shown when she saved part of her dinner along with the other guild members to present to the hero and partner when they had been denied dinner. She keeps a diary in her crew room which documents the events occurring in the storyline from her perspective. {{-}} ===Diary=== Sunflora's Oh My Gosh Diary documents events of the storyline, provides some tips for the game, and [[Breaking the fourth wall|breaks the fourth wall]] once, akin to Bidoof's Yup Yup Journal. When the hero is exploring the [[Waterfall Cave|waterfall]], the diary has four entries, as seen in [[Today's "Oh My Gosh"|Sunflora's special episode]]. {{spoilers}} {| class="expandable" | |- | :1.
